description: Machine-readable neuro/physics contradiction ledger for GeoSync. Each entry is grounded in a source path + line evidence and mapped to an owner remediation lane. Closure requires evidence (resolution_ref); claims without evidence are UNSUPPORTED, not silently passed. Verified against real source on 2026-06-17 against the repo's own canon — most anticipated contradictions are already bounded; only one is a true HIGH violation.

contradictions.title: system_free_energy fuses thermodynamic free energy with operational cost
contradictions.contradiction: system_free_energy() composes a Boltzmann-scaled term (K_BOLTZMANN_EFFECTIVE=1.38e-23, _KT_PRODUCT) with operational/DevOps costs (latency_cost, incoherence_cost) and adds entropy as a penalty under the name 'free energy', colliding with canon F=U-T*S (INV-FE2) where entropy LOWERS F. Two distinct ontologies are summed; neither stays unit-consistent.
contradictions.evidence: core/energy.py:75 K_BOLTZMANN_EFFECTIVE=1.38e-23; :147 free_energy = internal_energy + resource_term + entropy_term; canon INV-FE2 ThermodynamicState.gibbs_energy. RESOLVED by #1146 (merge 3a510870): operational-cost vs thermodynamic free energy split into distinct unit-contracted quantities; entropy no longer summed as a free-energy penalty.

contradictions.title: Declared dopamine/serotonin correlation invariant is never checked (dead invariant)
contradictions.contradiction: The config field dopamine_serotonin_correlation_min=-0.8 is documented as a 'Minimum inverse correlation expectation' invariant, but validate_state() (line 208) never references it. A declared integrity invariant that is not enforced is a silent claim with no witness.
contradictions.evidence: core/validation/neuro_integrity.py:146 field default -0.8; grep of validate_state body shows no use of dopamine_serotonin_correlation_min

contradictions.title: Scalar [0,1] clamp comment labelled 'biological plausibility'
contradictions.contradiction: A clamp of the serotonin level to [0,1] is justified in-comment as 'biological plausibility'. A bounded scalar is a normalisation choice, not biophysical evidence (no receptor kinetics, concentration units, or physiological range). Comment-level overclaim of the model class; the dynamics themselves are bio-inspired bounded heuristics.
contradictions.evidence: core/neuro/serotonin_ode.py:118 '# Clamp level to [0, 1] for biological plausibility'

contradictions.title: 'STDP-like' label on RPE-gated weight in one metaphor module
contradictions.contradiction: gaba_position_gate calls RPE-sign weight adaptation 'STDP-like plasticity' with no spike-timing relation. This is a metaphor label in one module ONLY: real spike-timing STDP exists in modules/gaba_inhibition_gate.py (stdp_tau_plus_ms=16.8, a_plus, exp(-delta_t_ms/tau_plus) at line 325). Actionable scope is a rename/clarification of the metaphor, not a missing mechanism.
contradictions.evidence: core/neuro/gaba_position_gate.py:102 'STDP-like plasticity' (RPE sign); modules/gaba_inhibition_gate.py:325 real exp(-delta_t_ms/stdp_tau_plus_ms)

contradictions.title: Monotonic-descent / delta-F gate is ALREADY implemented (anticipated gap unsupported)
contradictions.contradiction: The program anticipates 'monotonic descent asserted without an explicit delta-F transition gate'. Verification shows the gate already exists: ecs_regulator._enforce_strict_monotonic_descent(new_fe, previous_fe) (line 380, applied at 611) plus core.energy.delta_free_energy(F_prev, F_now, dt) plus INV-FE1/FE3 already enforce dF<=0. No remediation PR is warranted.

contradictions.title: R / Ricci structure-vs-alpha boundary is bounded by product canon, not an enforced invariant
contradictions.contradiction: The no-alpha boundary lives in a module docstring and is reinforced by PRODUCT_CATEGORY.md / CLAUDE.md ('research verification, not asserted market edge'). It is therefore bounded at the documentation layer, but no executable invariant test asserts repo-wide that Kuramoto R / Ricci are structure and that any Kelly/alpha scaling requires an empirical IC/backtest gate. Optional hardening, not an open violation.
contradictions.evidence: core/kuramoto/capital_weighted.py:7,40,43 no-alpha disclaimer; PRODUCT_CATEGORY.md research-not-edge boundary; core/physics/free_energy_trading_gate.py F->portfolio bridge

contradictions.title: Orchestrator-as-neural-controller claim not present in current code
contradictions.contradiction: The program anticipates an 'orchestrator is a neural controller / basal ganglia' overclaim. A grep across core/agent/orchestrator.py and core/orchestrator/ finds no 'controller', 'basal ganglia', or 'neural controller' assertion (only a NEUROMODULATION enum label in interaction_sequencer.py). The contradiction is not evidenced in the current tree; lane-6 is preventive only.
contradictions.evidence: grep -niE 'controller|basal|neural controller' core/agent/orchestrator.py core/orchestrator/ -> only interaction_sequencer.py:24 NEUROMODULATION enum
